_Posted by Kunal's robot (Claude Opus 5.5) ↓_
>
> ## Motivation
>
> `wrap_shm_features()` copies each decoded feature tensor into a POSIX shared-memory segment. It runs on the tokenizer manager's event loop, so a request with several large images holds the loop, and `/health` with it, for the length of the copy.
>
> ```
> before:  loop  [tokenize][===== shm copy =====][send]
> after:   loop  [tokenize]  ...serves others...  [send]
>          pool             [===== shm copy =====]
> ```
>
> ## Modifications
>
> - Run the copy in the default executor, the same way the CUDA VMM transport already publishes features.
> - Unlink the segments if the request is cancelled mid-copy.
> - Add two tests to `test_gpu_feature_transport.py`: the loop stays responsive during the copy, and cancellation unlinks the segments.
>
> This PR is independent of #44574 and #44576, which address the same workload.
>
> ## Accuracy Tests
>
> Not applicable: the copied bytes are unchanged.
>
> ## Speed Tests and Profiling
>
> The tensor copy releases the GIL. Copying 40 MB left a 1.4 ms worst-case event-loop gap from a worker thread, against 12 ms on the loop.
>
> End to end, together with #44574 and #44576, see the table in #44574.
>

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep SHM cleanup alive after repeated cancellation**

When a request is cancelled a second time while the executor is still copying (for example, task cancellation followed by loop shutdown), this unshielded `await future` is interrupted and cancels only the asyncio wrapper; the already-running worker still returns a tokenized object containing named `ShmPointerMMData` segments, but `discard_shm_features` is never called. +    async def _wrap_shm_features_async(
+        self,
+        tokenized_obj: Union[TokenizedGenerateReqInput, TokenizedEmbeddingReqInput],
+    ) -> Union[TokenizedGenerateReqInput, TokenizedEmbeddingReqInput]:
+        """Copy features into shared memory without blocking the event loop.
+
+        Decoded images reach hundreds of MB per request; copying them on the

+        """

+        )
+        try:
+            return await asyncio.shield(future)
+        except asyncio.CancelledError:

+class TestShmFeatureDispatch(unittest.TestCase):
+    @staticmethod
+    def _tokenized_obj():
+        from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import (
+            Modality,
+            MultimodalDataItem,
+            MultimodalProcessorOutput,
+        )
+
+        items = [MultimodalDataItem(modality=Modality.IMAGE, feature=torch.arange(2))]
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            rid="test-request",
+            mm_inputs=MultimodalProcessorOutput(input_ids=[1], mm_items=items),
+        )
+
+    def test_features_are_wrapped_off_the_event_loop(self):
+        from sglang.srt.managers import tokenizer_manager
+
+        manager = object.__new__(tokenizer_manager.TokenizerManager)
+        wrap_threads = []
+
+        def wrap(obj):
+            wrap_threads.append(threading.get_ident())
+            return obj
+
+        async def send():
+            with patch.object(tokenizer_manager, "wrap_shm_features", wrap):
+                await manager._wrap_shm_features_async(self._tokenized_obj())
+            return threading.get_ident()
+
+        loop_thread = asyncio.run(send())
+
+        self.assertEqual(len(wrap_threads), 1)
+        self.assertNotEqual(wrap_threads[0], loop_thread)
+
+    def test_cancelled_dispatch_discards_wrapped_features(self):
+        from sglang.srt.managers import tokenizer_manager
+
+        manager = object.__new__(tokenizer_manager.TokenizerManager)
+        tokenized_obj = self._tokenized_obj()
+        wrap_started = threading.Event()
+        release_wrap = threading.Event()
+
+        def wrap(obj):
+            wrap_started.set()
+            release_wrap.wait()
+            return obj
+
+        async def cancel_mid_wrap():
+            task = asyncio.create_task(manager._wrap_shm_features_async(tokenized_obj))
+            await asyncio.to_thread(wrap_started.wait)
+            task.cancel()
+            release_wrap.set()
+            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.CancelledError):
+                await task
+
+        discard = MagicMock()
+        with (
+            patch.object(tokenizer_manager, "wrap_shm_features", wrap),
+            patch.object(tokenizer_manager, "discard_shm_features", discard),
+        ):
+            asyncio.run(cancel_mid_wrap())
+
+        discard.assert_called_once_with(tokenized_obj)
+
